title: Receipt extraction: image to validated structured JSON
userStory: As a user, after I confirm a receipt photo, Structly extracts vendor, date, net, VAT, gross and category into structured data with a validation check, so I can turn it into a spreadsheet.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/extractReceipt.js exports an injectable extractReceipt(image, { client }) returning { fields, validation }, where client is a pluggable vision client (real by default, a fake injected in tests)
validation flags needs-review when net + vat does not equal gross within a small tolerance (VAT-math reconciliation)
fields normalizes date to ISO and amounts to numbers, flagging any missing or low-confidence field
scripts/verify-acceptance.js tests extractReceipt with a fake client covering a clean receipt, a VAT-mismatch receipt (flagged), and a missing-field receipt (flagged)
npm test passes and no real network call happens in tests
No Google or OAuth dependency is added
